title: The 5 Longest Bridges on Earth, Ranked (#1 Is Over 100 Miles Long)

scenes.text: The five longest bridges on Earth, ranked. Number one is longer than a hundred miles.

scenes.label: Weinan Weihe · 79.7 km
scenes.text: Number five: the Weinan Weihe Grand Bridge in China. About forty-nine miles of railway bridge.

scenes.label: Cangde · about 106 km
scenes.text: Number four: the Cangde Grand Bridge, also in China. About sixty-six miles long.

scenes.label: Tianjin · 113.7 km
scenes.text: Number three: the Tianjin Grand Bridge. About seventy miles, also carrying high-speed trains.

scenes.label: Changhua-Kaohsiung · 157 km
scenes.text: Number two: the Changhua Kaohsiung Viaduct in Taiwan. Nearly ninety-eight miles long.

scenes.label: Danyang-Kunshan · 164.8 km
scenes.text: Number one: the Danyang Kunshan Grand Bridge. About one hundred and two miles of bridge, in one piece.
